offset.description: Page number inside the requested collection. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list)

pageSize.description: Number of elements to display per page. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list)

filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions. Accepts the same format as returned by
the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. Currently supported filters
are:

- page: Filter grid by work package (operations: list)

rowCount.description: The number of rows the grid has — integer >= 1 (numeric string ok) (operations: create, update)

columnCount.description: The number of columns the grid has — integer >= 1 (numeric string ok) (operations: create, update)

widgets.description:
The set of `GridWidget`s selected for the grid.

# Conditions

- The widgets must not overlap. (operations: create, update)

id.description: Grid id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: get, update, update_form)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
